history_policy: up to 10 years of Tencent daily history; data-limited stocks use all available bars
web_chart_policy: latest 1200 bars per eligible stock; full-history signal calculation remains server-side
web_ema_policy: EMA12/144/169/576/676 calculated from the full available 10-year Tencent history and aligned to displayed bars
cache_policy: per-symbol gzip CSV and metadata; 14-day overlap incremental merge
warmup_policy: request up to 10 years of Tencent daily history; use all available bars without a minimum-history rejection
